description: This file defines the class 'AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewEdit', which extends 'ViewEdit' and manages the editing view for PDF templates within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for rendering the edit interface, setting up dynamic form fields, and initializing TinyMCE editors for rich text editing.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to provide custom editing interface for PDF templates, including sample file loading, module field configuration, and TinyMCE editor setup.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to display the edit view, setting fields and initializing rich text editor.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Prepares form fields, loads sample files, configures module field options dynamically, and prepares HTML for insert fields.

methods.name: displayTMCE
methods.description: Initializes TinyMCE editors for description, header, and footer sections with specific configurations.
